thread:
Priya (Partnerships PM): Heads-up — partners reporting failing inferences on marketplace images after the newest driver + CUDA combo landed. Seen on a handful of customer repros and our internal smoke tests. tagging @Diego @Sam @Jin @Marta :alert:

Diego (Eng Runtime): Thanks. Can you paste the failing stack traces? Is it deterministic or flakey?

Priya (Partnerships PM): Repro is fairly consistent on FP16 quantized models with long context. Short repro here: customer runs model X on AMI 'redwood-mkt-llm-2026-03', gets CUDA kernel OOM or illegal-instruction in logs. Attaching snippet from their run: ```
ERROR: cuLaunchKernel() failed: 702
stack: /opt/redwood/lib/quant-kernel.so(+0x4a1f2)
```

Sam (Eng ML): That 702 error maps to an illegal instruction on some older drivers when AVX/SM flags mismatch. Which driver version is in that AMI?

Priya (Partnerships PM): The AMI has driver 535.86, CUDA 12.3 pinned. We validated an older AMI with driver 534.x looked fine.

Diego (Eng Runtime): Ok — two quick paths: 1) suggest partners pin to 534.x until we triage. 2) create a hotfix build of the quant-kernel with an instruction set guard. I can run a bisect between 534 -> 535 to find syscall/regression point.

Jin (Partner ENG - NVIDIA): We're aware of a compatibility edge with 535.x and certain PTX codegen patterns when quant kernels use inline asm for warp shuffles. We have an internal patch queued (driver hotfix branch nv/hotfix/535-quant) that addresses register allocation for those kernels. Can share signed driver package for testing.

Marta (Marketplace PM - AWS): We have ~30 AMIs live referencing the marketplace listing. If partners want us to, we can temporarily mark the affected AMI family as 'Do not distribute' while you validate. Prefer to avoid full delist.

Priya (Partnerships PM): Preferred short-term plan: ask customers to pin to 534.x, AWS to set AMI to 'do not distribute' for the affected image id(s), and Intel/AMD partners to hold on updates. Mid-term: test NVIDIA's hotfix on our internal fleet and update marketplace images + release notes.

Diego (Eng Runtime): I'll start the bisect and try a repro matrix across drivers [532, 533, 534, 535]. Sam — can you add the failing model + prompt to our repro harness? Put it under infra/tests/marketplace/regressions so QA can run. Example command to run the repro harness: ```bash
./infra/repro/run_repro.sh --ami redwood-mkt-llm-2026-03 --model X --precision fp16 --context 4096
```

Sam (Eng ML): On it. I'll also try toggling kernel flags and run with CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1 to get line numbers.

Jin (Partner ENG - NVIDIA): I'll send the signed hotfix driver tarball to the secure share in 30m. Please do not publicize channel link. If it validates, we can coordinate a staged driver push for partners and provide clear driver pinning guidance.

Marta (Marketplace PM - AWS): Once validated, we can push a new AMI with driver 535.fix and update Marketplace listing metadata (changelog + compatibility note). We need a clear semver-style label so customers know which AMIs are safe.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered by Diego -> infra/repro on host infra-runner-42. status: queued

Priya (Partnerships PM): Action items: Diego -> bisect + repro (owner). Sam -> add repro + run with flags (owner). Jin -> drop hotfix tarball to secure share (owner). Marta -> mark AMI family DND and prepare to update listing once we greenlight (owner). We'll reconvene in 90 minutes unless someone needs more time. :thumbsup:

Diego (Eng Runtime): Starting bisect now — will post logs. If we can confirm regression introduced in driver, we'll ask NVIDIA for an advisory and coordinate a hotfix rollout.

Sam (Eng ML): Repro harness added: infra/tests/marketplace/regressions/2026-03-ami-quant-fp16.sh. Running now.

Jin (Partner ENG - NVIDIA): Hotfix uploaded to secure share: s3://nv-hotfix/testing/535-quant-2026-03.tar.gpg. Sent access to Diego and Priya by DM.

Priya (Partnerships PM): Good momentum. Please paste any customer-impacted AMI ids here so we can annotate support tickets. I'll update the partners tracker and ping legal if any public advisory is needed.

Diego (Eng Runtime): Bisect found the first bad commit in driver ABI change set mapping to 535.12 -> 535.30 range. Reproduced illegal-instruction on infra-runner-42 with hotfix driver it's fixed. Writing up short repro + logs at http://internal.redwood/repro/1779005678 (internal-only).

Priya (Partnerships PM): Excellent. Let's hold on public comms until we coordinate with NVIDIA. Thanks everyone — will follow up with a short summary and next steps in 60m.
